scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c auto "npm run dev -w @inventaire/web" "npm run dev -w @inventaire/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @inventaire/shared && npm run build -w @inventaire/api && npm run build -w @inventaire/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @inventaire/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c auto "PORT=3001 npm run start -w @inventaire/api" "npm run start -w @inventaire/web"
